title: UI风格#101 - Nordic Winter (北欧冬日)
description: 创建第101种UI风格：北欧冬日风格 - 冰雪覆盖、木屋温暖、极夜氛围。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planCW.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Winter style When color palette Then features ice blue, snow white, pine green, firelight amber
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#E8F4F8 (冰蓝), #FFFAFA (雪白), #228B22 (松绿), #FFB347 (火光琥珀), #2F4F4F (极夜蓝)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Winter style When typography Then uses nordic fonts: Montserrat, Josefin Sans, or Lato
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Montserrat (标题), Josefin Sans (正文), Lato (替代)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Winter style When layout Then snow drifts, cabin windows, aurora gradients, frozen lakes
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：雪堆、小屋窗户、极光、冻湖、木质纹理

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Winter style When UI elements Then frost patterns, candle glow, snowflakes, ice crystals
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：霜花图案、烛光、雪片、冰晶、温暖的炉火

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Winter UI When functional Then includes hygge chat, settler agents, warmth stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：舒适聊天、居民代理、温暖统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Winter UI When copy Then uses scandinavian: 'Hygge', 'Aurora', 'Fjord', 'Frost'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'HYGGE. AURORA. FJORD.'、按钮'SEND'→'SETTLE'、'SUBMIT'→'SHELTER'
